The '''Zakuulans''' were a cultural group of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]]. Before the rule of the [[Eternal Empire]] and [[Tenebrae]]&mdash;under the guise of the Zakuulan [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Valkorion]]&mdash;the Zakuulans worshipped the [[Six Gods]].<ref name="KOTFE" />
